scope: Coordinated Apparel business setup with opening stock and Promotion setup contributions alongside existing products, CMS and Media

implementation.baseline: sample-v001, version 0.0.1; optional documentation remains docs-v001
implementation.applicationOwner: agora.apparel owns branded sample choices and setup profile; framework Inventory and Promotion own operational effects
implementation.composition: kickoffCore explicitly references only the two selected Apparel contributions in the COMMERCE role; the application module remains inactive there. Local and Docker selection contracts are tested.
implementation.ordering: Existing catalogue and Media setup plus existing CMS/Media approvals precede required AFTER_PUBLICATION operational contributions. Original human authorization is forwarded through existing nImport execution.
implementation.readiness: Status is read-only. Pending approval, failed Media qualification, rollback and retirement do not execute operational contributions. All required operational receipts must be CURRENT before READY.
implementation.inventory: Inventory-owned first receipt atomically inserts balance, movement and private original-intent evidence. Replay never replenishes consumed stock. Installed transaction policy, atomic provider, eligible schemas and actual unique indexes are required. Complete pack preflight precedes writes; atomicity is per receipt, not the entire pack.
implementation.promotion: Activated scoped policy and absence of prior operational consumption permit a first-use budget admission. Private guards and existing consumption/reversal preserve original evidence and current spend. Authorized replay does not replace the original actor.
implementation.couponLimit: Coupon intents are validated but intentionally not executable without a qualified private token-retention/reveal owner. A nonempty intent list blocks the entire contribution before campaign writes. No new vault, authority flag or plaintext redeemable code was introduced.
implementation.sharedPayloadReader: nImport requalifies immutable descriptors and bounded selected declared JSON bytes. Symlinks, traversal, changed provenance, unknown owner/installer, unsafe file names and unbounded payloads fail closed.
implementation.documentation: Detailed owner contracts, tables, Mermaid flow diagrams and Inventory CMS records explain operations, replay, ordering, customization and qualification boundaries.
implementation.inventoryDocumentationBaseline: Unreleased Inventory docs-v001 hashes were refreshed using the existing manifest checksum/section-validation owner. Immutable-generation comparison correctly refused changed 0.0.1 bytes; that runtime guard was not altered or bypassed. Existing installed documentation receipts were not overwritten; deployment requires its governed fresh-init or reviewed forward handling.

native.startup: All ten native runtimes reached READY after source stabilization and rebuild, using the user's previously verified private-capture launch selection. No repository qualification setting was changed.
native.mode: Authenticated operator preflight and read-only owner API inspection; no install or application initiate request

importValidate.discoveredStatuses: Both exact contributions discovered as NOT_INSTALLED, version 0.0.1

inventoryDiagnosis.authority: Authenticated generated Product capabilities and exact Store/locale safe-search, followed by public Product owner delivery reads
inventoryDiagnosis.conclusion: The full opening pack lacks required Online catalogue projections. Publish and activate its full scoped catalogue through existing governed owners, then rerun all owner preflight checks. This does not independently qualify every warehouse or installed transaction prerequisite.

native.lastSourceCorrection: After stopping the runtimes, standardized Promotion preflight to ERR_PROMOTION_SETUP_TOKEN_OWNER_REQUIRED so BackOffice preserves the typed blocker. Promotion and BackOffice regression tests passed. Native observations above precede this code-only diagnostic correction; it was not deployed or rechecked live.
